title: Computational structural insights into alternative proteins: The impact of AlphaFold and AI-based prediction.
authors: Natarajan, Shiammala Periyasamy; Ramarajan, Bagavathi Lakshmi; Sivakumar, Rani; Mani, Jayaprakashvel
journal: Advances in protein chemistry and structural biology
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦AlphaFold等AI方法在替代蛋白（植物、微生物等）结构预测中的应用，对象为蛋白质结构且方法涉及AI预测，但以应用综述为主、缺乏方法创新，故评6分。
abstract: Proteins are fundamental biomolecules composed of amino acids linked by peptide bonds, forming complex macromolecules that determine cellular structure and biological function. The three-dimensional conformation of proteins plays a crucial role in defining their biochemical activity, stability, and interactions. In the emerging field of alternative proteins, such as microbial, algal, plant-based, and precision-fermented proteins, understanding structural organization is essential for improving functional properties including digestibility, nutritional value, texture, and enzymatic performance. Experimental determination of protein structures through conventional techniques remains time-consuming, technically demanding, and expensive. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence have revolutionized protein structure prediction, particularly with the development of AlphaFold by Google DeepMind. AlphaFold integrates deep learning algorithms, attention mechanisms, and evolutionary information derived from multiple sequence alignments to accurately predict spatial relationships among amino acid residues. Its performance has been validated through the Critical Assessment of Structure Prediction (CASP) competitions, demonstrating unprecedented accuracy in computational structure prediction. The application of AlphaFold provides significant opportunities for accelerating research in alternative proteins by enabling rapid structural characterization, enzyme engineering, and functional optimization of novel protein sources. This review highlights the scientific developments that led to AlphaFold, describes its architectural innovations, and discusses its potential applications in alternative protein discovery, design, and processing. Furthermore, current limitations and future perspectives in AI-assisted structural prediction for sustainable protein production are discussed.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质是由氨基酸通过肽键连接而成的基本生物分子，形成决定细胞结构和生物学功能的复杂大分子。蛋白质的三维构象在定义其生化活性、稳定性和相互作用方面起着至关重要的作用。在新兴的替代蛋白质领域，如微生物、藻类、植物基和精密发酵蛋白质，理解结构组织对于改善功能特性（包括消化性、营养价值、质地和酶学性能）至关重要。通过传统技术实验测定蛋白质结构仍然耗时、技术要求高且成本高昂。人工智能的最新进展彻底改变了蛋白质结构预测，尤其是谷歌DeepMind开发的AlphaFold。AlphaFold整合了深度学习算法、注意力机制和源自多序列比对的进化信息，以准确预测氨基酸残基之间的空间关系。其性能已通过蛋白质结构预测关键评估（CASP）竞赛得到验证，展示了计算结构预测中前所未有的准确性。AlphaFold的应用为加速替代蛋白质研究提供了重要机遇，能够实现快速结构表征、酶工程和新蛋白质来源的功能优化。本综述重点介绍了促成AlphaFold的科学进展，描述了其架构创新，并讨论了其在替代蛋白质发现、设计和加工中的潜在应用。此外，还讨论了当前局限性以及人工智能辅助结构预测在可持续蛋白质生产中的未来前景。
